title: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time
subtitle: Two partners on separate journeys

body: Ratchet & Clank Future: A Crack in Time is Insomniac Games' PlayStation 3 platform shooter, released in North America on 27 October 2009. Ratchet searches for Clank while learning more about the Lombaxes, and Clank discovers his connection to the Great Clock. Their separation gives each character a different kind of adventure. Ratchet explores planets with an expanding arsenal; Clank solves problems whose main material is time. The story brings together mysteries introduced earlier in the Future saga while keeping the partnership at the centre of its conclusion.

Clank can record his actions on special time pads and leave a holographic copy to replay them. The player then performs another part of the task while the recorded Clank repeats its route. Several recordings can work together, holding switches or opening paths in an ordered sequence. Solving a room involves planning what each version must do and when the next action becomes possible. The puzzle turns a single controlled character into a small coordinated team whose other members are the player's own previous decisions.

Ratchet gains hoverboots that carry him quickly across surfaces and launch him over gaps. Space travel also provides small moons and optional activities between the major destinations, giving the search a less direct route. Weapons retain the series' comic effects and improve through use, while Clank's staff repairs damaged objects inside the Clock. Brian Allgeier directed, with Boris Salchow composing the score. Critics praised the combination of story and play. The adventure became a major conclusion to the Future storyline before Into the Nexus supplied a later epilogue.
